title: Permissions: a role without Delete sees the tracking switch disabled; View only cannot change parts
custom_preconds:
• Role A: Part Library & Inventory View + Create & Edit, Delete unticked.
  • Role B: Part Library & Inventory View only.
  • One tracked and one untracked part.
custom_steps:
1. As role A open the untracked part.
  2. Change its description, Save.
  3. As role A replay POST /api/inventory/parts/change flipping isTracked.
  4. As role B replay POST /api/inventory/parts/change for any part.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • The tracking switch is visible, disabled and shows the saved state (OFF).

Step 2:

  • The edit saves.

Step 3:

  • 201 (D14, by design; do not log a bug).

Step 4:

  • 403; nothing changes.
